title: Sources and documents
content:
This register separates public evidence, my own project material and supplied background documents. It gives a reader a way to check the dated public claims and understand which version of the programme this handover follows.

Public roles and project status are recorded as at **24 October 2026**. A changing role, law, funding programme or project timetable needs a fresh check when a real decision is made.

## How the sources are used

The State Library, council, parliament, legislation and other institutional records support the public facts attributed to them. My repositories and websites establish what my projects currently propose or demonstrate. They do not establish an external organisation's agreement.

My account of our meeting, your video interview with me and the other meetings is personal recollection. The Mau lecture has a surviving public recording. The separate interview you made with me remains to be located.

Supplied documents provide background and version history. They are summarised here; private contact details and the original attachments are not reproduced. Some older AI-assisted documents overstate technical capabilities or describe C-Hours commercially. The current reciprocal definition and the clarifications in this wiki govern the handover.

## Bruce Mau and the 2011 visit

### S01

[State Library of Queensland: Nielson Design Lecture with Bruce Mau](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-3Zr3dsGq7I). Official lecture recording, 1:08:56. Its description identifies 23 November 2011 and Auditorium 1.

### S02

[Indesignlive: Bruce Mau on Massive Change](https://www.indesignlive.com/articles/bruce-mau-on-massive-change), 11 November 2011. Contemporary announcement and interview giving the advertised lecture time and 24-26 November workshop dates. The [25 November report](https://www.indesignlive.com/articles/designing-our-future-bruce-mau) describes the event after it occurred.

### S03

[Library Board of Queensland Annual Report 2011-12](https://documents.parliament.qld.gov.au/tp/2012/5412T1444.pdf), printed page 26. Host record of Mau's visit, government discussions, North Quarter work and the world's first workshop in that named format. The relevant passage was recovered through indexed text; direct retrieval of the PDF was unavailable during research.

### S04

[Bruce Mau Design: Massive Change](https://www.brucemaudesign.com/work/massive-change). The original practice's project account. The [author's book page](https://brucemaustudio.com/books/massive-change/) describes the 2004 book and its eleven sections.

### S05

[Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago: Massive Change](https://mcachicago.org/whats-on/exhibitions/massive-change-the-future-of-global-design/). Host account of the 16 September-31 December 2006 exhibition and its collaborators. This is an exhibition record, distinct from the later Brisbane lecture and workshop.

### S06

[ABC News: State Library reopens after Brisbane floods](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2011-02-16/state-library-reopens-after-brisbane-floods/1945446), 16 February 2011. Contemporary record of the library's own closure and reopening.

For the later development of Mau's work, useful additional sources are [MC24](https://www.massivechangenetwork.com/mc24), the [2015 principles document](https://designmanifestos.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/24hrs2mc-principles.pdf), [UNSW's 2022 residency account](https://www.unsw.edu.au/news/2022/12/how-to-create-massive-change-bruce-maus-impact-on-unsw) and the [Massive Action Sydney project record](https://www.unsw.edu.au/innovation-hub/our-work/massive-action-sydney). The later principles document is not verified as the handout used in Brisbane in 2011.

## People and public roles

### S07

[Redland City Council: Paul Bishop, Division 10](https://www.redland.qld.gov.au/About-Council/Mayor-and-Councillors/Mayor-and-councillor-profiles/Division-10-Birkdale-Thorneside). Official profile for division, first election, professional background and listed public connections.

### S08

[Redland City Council: councillor portfolio system](https://www.redlandscoasttoday.com.au/2025/04/council-implements-councillor-portfolio-system/), April 2025. Allocates Arts, Culture and Heritage to you, Environment and Local Laws to Julie, and Economic Development to Peter for the remainder of the term. Later council reporting in 2026 confirms the continuing portfolio context.

### S09

[Redland City Council: Julie Talty, Division 6](https://www.redland.qld.gov.au/About-Council/Mayor-and-Councillors/Mayor-and-councillor-profiles/Division-6-Mt-Cotton-Redland-Bay). Official Deputy Mayor, division and background record. See also [council's January 2026 environmental report](https://www.redlandscoasttoday.com.au/2026/01/redland-city-reports-first-city-wide-koala-population-stabilisation-in-south-east-queensland/).

### S10

[Redland City Council: Peter Mitchell, Division 2](https://www.redland.qld.gov.au/About-Council/Mayor-and-Councillors/Mayor-and-councillor-profiles/Division-2-Cleveland-North-Stradbroke-Island). Official division and professional background. [Council's July 2026 report](https://www.redlandscoasttoday.com.au/2026/07/redlands-coast-set-for-visitor-boost-as-junior-state-cup-returns/) identifies his Economic Development portfolio.

### S11

[Amanda Stoker: About Amanda](https://www.amandastoker.com.au/aboutamanda). Her account of upbringing, study, legal work and public career. It is a first-person political biography.

### S12

[Parliament of Australia: Amanda Stoker](https://www.aph.gov.au/Senators_and_Members/Parliamentarian?MPID=237920). Federal service, ministerial and parliamentary committee record. Indexed parliamentary material was used where the full page was access-restricted.

### S13

[Queensland Government: Premier appoints Child Safety Minister to continue reform agenda](https://statements.qld.gov.au/statements/106297), 24 October 2026. Official announcement of Amanda Stoker's new ministry and Natalie Marr's assistant ministry. [ABC's same-day report](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-10-24/premier-cabinet-change-amanda-stoker-camm-child-safety-dv/107304396) provides a second account of the portfolios.

### S14

[Henry Pike: portfolios](https://www.henrypike.com.au/portfolios) and [appointment announcement](https://www.henrypike.com.au/pike_appointed_shadow_assistant_minister_for_disability_and_the_ndis_and_shadow_assistant_minister_for_mental_health). His public account of the federal opposition responsibilities held since February 2026.

### S15

[Kevin Rudd: biography](https://kevinrudd.com/about) and [Asia Society appointment announcement](https://asiasociety.org/asia-society-announces-appointment-hon-kevin-rudd-president-and-ceo). Support the public role and career context. The Asia Society announcement was available through indexed text where direct retrieval was restricted.

### S16

[Inter-Parliamentary Union: Milton Dick elected President](https://www.ipu.org/news/press-releases/2026-10/milton-dick-elected-president-ipu), 9 October 2026. Official record of his election, three-year term and parliamentary background.

## Council law and infrastructure

### S17

[Queensland Local Government Act 2009](https://www.legislation.qld.gov.au/view/whole/html/current/act-2009-017), sections 160-165, especially 161, 164 and 165. Primary law for the term, vacancy process and acting mayor. The 16 March 2027 threshold is calculated from the statutory third-anniversary rule and the 2024 election date.

### S18

[Electoral Commission Queensland: 2024 local government elections](https://www.ecq.qld.gov.au/elections/election-events/2024-election-events/2024-local-government-elections). Primary election record for 16 March 2024.

### S19

[Transport and Main Roads: Dunwich Ferry Terminal Upgrade](https://www.tmr.qld.gov.au/projects/dunwich-ferry-terminal-upgrade), update of 29 September 2026. Official $41 million commitment and planning position.

### S20

[TMR: consultation summary report](https://www.yoursay-projects.tmr.qld.gov.au/download_file/view/7051/1554), September 2026. Records consultation, community themes and project scope, including the exclusion of ferry-service consolidation.

## Public calendar

### S21

[Astronomical Society of Australia: future eclipses](https://eclipse.asa.astronomy.org.au/future-eclipses/). Dates and Australian paths for the coming total solar eclipses.

### S22

[Astronomical Association of Queensland: five Australian eclipses](https://www.eclipse.aaq.org.au/five-australian-eclipses). Includes the Australian sequence and the 2037 path through Brisbane.

### S23

[International Olympic Committee: Brisbane 2032 Games vision](https://www.olympics.com/ioc/news/brisbane-2032-unveils-official-games-vision-believe-belong-become-brisbane-2032). Official Olympic and Paralympic dates.

### S24

[Paul McCartney: Live Aid](https://www.paulmccartney.com/live/live-aid). Participant's official event record for 13 July 1985. The 50th anniversary is 13 July 2035.

## Scientific and clinical context

### S25

[NASA: planetary defence](https://science.nasa.gov/planetary-defense/) and [DART mission](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/dart/). Primary sources for asteroid observation and the demonstrated kinetic-impact deflection experiment.

### S26

[NOAA: effects of space weather on Earth](https://www.nesdis.noaa.gov/our-environment/space-weather/the-effects-of-space-weather-earth). Documents effects on satellites, power systems, communication and navigation. It does not establish the separate periodic solar-micronova hypothesis.

### S27

[TGA: risk of fire during use of hyperbaric chambers](https://www.tga.gov.au/safety/safety-monitoring-and-information/safety-alerts/risk-fire-during-use-hyperbaric-chambers), 10 October 2025. Australian equipment and operational context for the Genesis proposal.

### S28

[National Research Council: The Polygraph and Lie Detection](https://www.nationalacademies.org/read/10420/chapter/2), 2003. Research review relevant to limits on physiological inference about deception. The proposed Truth Engine has its own performance questions.

### S29

[Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital: Hyperbaric Medicine](https://metronorth.health.qld.gov.au/rbwh/healthcare-services/hyperbaric-medicine). Queensland clinical service context. [NHMRC human research guidance](https://www.nhmrc.gov.au/about-us/publications/national-statement-ethical-conduct-human-research-2025) is an additional reference for proposed research arrangements.

| Alignment | Work on the relationship between a system's behaviour, human intentions, values and consequences |
